newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas futures end down on mild forecasts.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas futures end down on mild forecasts.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures ended lower Tuesday in a moderate session, with forecasts for milder weather next week pressuring the complex though few had strong convictions about market direction, sources said.
December slumped 8.7 cents to close at $2.646 per million British thermal units. January settled 9.6 cents lower at $2.643. Other deferreds ended down by 1.5 to 4.4 cents.
"Technically, we held support. Cash is still over the screen, so we could move up," said one East Coast trader.
But he said mild weather next week would make it hard to sustain any move to the upside.
